Great question! Setting up your new Leesa mattress is easy and kind of fun. Here’s how to do it right the first time: 📦

Move the Box: Take the box to the room where the mattress will live.
Unbox with Care: Place the box on its side and pull out the rolled mattress. Be careful with any sharp objects!
Position and Unwrap: Place the rolled mattress on your foundation or base and remove the outer plastic wrap.
Unfold and Free: Tear away the inner plastic. Your mattress will start to expand right away!
Let it Breathe: It may take up to an hour to expand and a few days to fully firm up. It's best to let it air out for a few hours before putting on any sheets or your new mattress encasement.

A slight "new mattress" smell is normal and will fade quickly. Enjoy the magic!
